authorization: User requested execution of the plan on 2026-09-24; all code, inputs and results isolated; no manuscript integration.
numerical_settings: Full per-parent configuration, with only explicitly listed job overrides.
primary_metric: Integral of the recorded stress with respect to engineering strain to a stated endpoint; not fracture toughness.
primary_comparison: B-to-C: new trajectory at virtual original stop versus extended endpoint. A-to-B reproduction and A-to-C total shifts also reported.
failure_definition: Chronological driver criterion: lost spanning connectivity or stress below parent stop fraction of running peak after damage.
pilot_policy: Six extensions and two controls precede production. Agent reviews gate, reproduction flags and numerical quality before release.
unresolved_cases: Remain censored or numerically limited; no cap is substituted for an observed failure strain.
